title: Chapter 1342 - 21: Caution
content:
Chapter 1342 - 21: Caution

Chapter 1342: Chapter 21: Caution

The strength of an Entering Dao practitioner primarily depends on their Spiritual Power.

The stronger the Spiritual Power, the more powerful the Secret Techniques they can employ.

The more heaven and earth power they can invoke.

As for the physical body? That’s something martial artists of the Jianghu focus on.

In this world, even the most powerful physical body is still just that of common folk.

It cannot withstand poison, nor can it withstand a sharp blade.

A group of more than ten heavily armored soldiers surrounded them.

And they were directly chopped into minced meat.

Therefore, when Entering Dao practitioners engage in combat, they often first sense the opponent’s mental will.

Then determine whether to fight or flee.

The golden-robed man nearby didn’t feel Lin Yuan’s Spiritual Power fluctuations.

So he was dismissive, not taking him seriously at all.

But the golden-robed man standing in the middle thought more deeply.

If Lin Yuan were really just a commoner, why would he dare to intervene in matters between Entering Dao practitioners?

Whether it’s the four of them, the Entering Dao mages, or the hunchbacked old man not far away, they’re all Entering Dao practitioners.

Although the latter is just a regular Entering Dao practitioner, the fact that he attracted the personal pursuit of the four Entering Dao mages is proof of his strength.

So.

The golden-robed man in the middle realized something was off.

Instinctively, he activated a Secret Technique for investigation.

In this world, using Secret Techniques of the Entering Dao consumes Spiritual Power.

Unless necessary, no Entering Dao practitioner would casually activate Secret Techniques. "Such restrained Spiritual Power," the golden-robed man in the middle thought, shocked.

He secretly activated the Golden Dragon Sect’s detection Secret Technique and vaguely sensed that Lin Yuan did have Spiritual Power fluctuations.

But all the Spiritual Power was concentrated within his body.

Like an endless ocean.

On the surface, it seemed utterly calm and still.

But beneath, it was a surging undercurrent. "Senior Brother?"

The nearby golden-robed man looked puzzled but stopped and looked at the golden-robed man in the middle. "Are you the force behind him?"

The golden-robed man in the middle looked at Lin Yuan and said in a deep voice. "Yes."

Lin Yuan nodded. "In that case, the Golden Dragon Sect is at fault this time." "You may leave."

The golden-robed man in the middle thought repeatedly and then said.

He wasn’t confident about dealing with Lin Yuan; the impression Lin Yuan gave him was too unsettling.

Plus, since the Golden Dragon Sect was about to undergo a significant change, the golden-robed man in the middle did not plan to forcefully detain him.

The previous arrogance towards the hunchbacked old man’s third uncle was because he thought he could surely deal with him.

The other golden-robed men heard their senior brother’s decision, and although they didn’t know the specific reason, they understood their senior brother must have discovered something.

The golden-robed man who had originally walked out returned instead. "Leave?"

Lin Yuan looked at the four golden-robed men.

He wasn’t here just to save his third uncle.

But aimed at the entire Golden Dragon Sect and the vast Man State.

The Entering Dao Master from the Golden Dragon Sect was about to pass away; at such a time, taking action and secretly controlling them posed no hidden threat.

This was also the result of Lin Yuan observing several future timelines.

And Man State.

Geographically advantageous.

Originally, Lin Yuan only planned to establish trade routes.

Then slowly influence it over decades, eventually taking it into his fold.

Unexpectedly, this time, a shortcut appeared.

If he could seize Man State in advance, it would greatly benefit Lin Yuan’s upcoming plans. "I don’t intend to leave," Lin Yuan said. "Don’t intend to leave?"

The expressions of the golden-robed men nearby turned grim.

Their senior brother had already given so much face, yet the other party was still being so ungrateful?

Still not planning to leave? "Since you don’t intend to leave, then..." "Let’s go."

The golden-robed man in the middle found it increasingly unsettling the more he thought about it.

While reviewing, he suddenly realized he couldn’t figure out when exactly Lin Yuan appeared.

Entering Dao practitioners have strong Spiritual Power and are keenly aware of changes in their environment.

But determining when Lin Yuan appeared was impossible. "Leave."

The golden-robed man in the middle said, then turned and left immediately.

The other three golden-robed men exchanged glances and didn’t continue to argue with Lin Yuan’s arrogant words.

Instead, they closely followed behind their senior brother.

They knew their senior brother well.

While he seemed indifferent, he was extremely assertive.

Given his reaction now, there was undoubtedly something wrong. "Young Master." The hunchbacked old man’s third uncle looked at Lin Yuan, breathing a slight sigh of relief.

The Golden Dragon Sect was like the sky in Man State.

Outside the official Da Feng Dynasty, the Golden Dragon Sect was the strongest.

Even the Da Feng Dynasty was unwilling to clash with the Golden Dragon Sect in Man State.

Now that the four golden-robed men had voluntarily retreated, it was evidently the best outcome. "You won’t be able to leave either."

Lin Yuan’s expression remained calm.

In an instant, strands of Spiritual Power emerged from the surrounding void.

Constantly weaving and colliding, rapidly spreading in all directions.

Buzz～

With Lin Yuan at the center, Spiritual Power circulated within a hundred-zhang radius; the four golden-robed men within that radius were like being trapped in a spider’s web, unable to move.

The leading golden-robed man’s expression drastically changed; his mind trembled as he looked around in disbelief, "Heavenly Prison? Such a large-scale Heavenly Prison?"

The other three golden-robed men also felt their legs weaken, filled with fear, "Entering Dao Master?"

Entering Dao practitioners communicate with heaven and earth through Spiritual Power, but ordinary ones have weak Spiritual Power, and it can’t manifest externally.

Only upon reaching the realm of an Entering Dao mage can one barely manifest their Spiritual Power, but even then, it only extends a few feet around them.

However, for an Entering Dao Master, whose Spiritual Power is extremely powerful, it can purely form a prison with Spiritual Power to suppress the enemy.

That is the Heavenly Prison.
